revalidation_2026-07-28_294.adjudicator_notes:
Perfect run: recall 10/10 (1.00), specificity 9/9 (1.00), both well above the 0.80/0.50 gates. Row set has 19 entries (id 18 absent from the input); totals reflect the 19 rows supplied.

Reasoning-level adjudication (6.5 step 4) confirmed every pick token — no overrides needed:
- All 10 recall rows cite the H-described capability by name (OAR config/config.json/user.json conditions, DAR _conditions.txt conversion, priority/winner resolution, gating by weapon type, keyword, perk, race, time, magic effect, Math plugin). No borderline reasoning.
- Rows 15 and 19 both mention OAR in their reasoning but explicitly rule it out and pick N — correctly reasoned negatives, not accidental hits. Row 15 distinguishes skeleton/rigging from animation condition selection; row 19 distinguishes Nemesis/Pandora behavior generation from OAR condition configs. That boundary language is the strongest signal H's description is drawing the right edge: it claims condition-based selection and winner resolution, not behavior-engine regeneration or NIF/skeleton work.
- Rows 11-14, 16-17 route cleanly to the adjacent distributor/perf/lookup skills (SPID, KID, SkyPatcher, papyrus-optimization, biped-slot-reference, facegen-diagnostics) with no H pull, including the two designed near-misses that embed animation vocabulary in a non-OAR task: row 11 "idle-marker spell" (went to SPID on the distribution verb) and row 17 "dark face after a new animation pack" (went to facegen on the symptom, correctly treating the animation pack as a red herring). Row 14's "RegisterForAnimationEvent" likewise did not drag it to H.

No description change warranted for trigger reliability. The one thing to watch on future runs is the animation-adjacent negative cluster (15, 19, 20) — those held on reasoning that no skill covers behavior generation, skeleton nodes, or NIF texture paths, i.e. on H's absence of a claim rather than an explicit exclusion. If a later skill or a broadened H description starts asserting anything about animation assets or behavior patching, re-run those three first.
